articles.title: Aave rolls out vaults for yield-hungry fintech investors
articles.snippet: Aave's new Stable Vaults product lets wallets, exchanges and payment apps offer yields on stablecoin deposits

articles.title: Sony secures conditional approval to set up U.S. stablecoin trust bank
articles.snippet: The New York-based subsidiary, fully owned by Sony Bank, will be capitalized with $40 million to support its upcoming stablecoin business operations.

articles.title: Sony Bank gets US regulator nod to issue stablecoins
articles.snippet: Sony Bank received preliminary approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish a US stablecoin issuance business, with $40 million in starting capital.

articles.title: Revolut says USDT delisting is limited to EEA, Switzerland
articles.snippet: Revolut said USDT support remains unchanged outside EEA and Switzerland as it winds down the stablecoin offering in selected European markets.

articles.title: Bank of Korea stands firm on bank-led stablecoin push as deposit token pilots advance
articles.snippet: The Bank of Korea reiterated its call for bank-led won stablecoin issuance while advancing deposit token pilots, as issuer rules remain a sticking point in South Korea’s digital asset bill.
